title: Art is generated in code from the map data; what looks solid is solid
intent: Give the game an original pixel-art look with no image files, without letting the picture disagree with collision

evidence.description: pixel art, layered city, HUD restyle
pixel scan finds 0 stray obstacle pixels and 0 holes inside solids

constraints.statement: Every texture is drawn in code once at boot (BootScene) with nearest-neighbour filtering; restarts reuse them

The city layers are drawn from cityMap SOLIDS; every obstacle pixel lies inside a collision rectangle and every rectangle is fully drawn, so nothing walkable looks solid and nothing solid looks walkable
Ground detail is flat (no outlines or height); foreground art covers under 0.3 percent of walkable ground
Gameplay depths stay fixed (enemies 1, bullets 2, player 3, thrown rock 4); art layers fit around them per src/art/layers.ts
